1Password Generic / System Account Review - Service & Generic Service Account Manual Inventory Across 70+ applications - Uplift

PwC manually built a 78-system inventory and is validating account types, ownership, and 1Password coverage with system owners, requiring substantial coordination and follow-up. Remaining work includes obtaining Q3 & Q4 application access listings, completing account-to-vault mapping, and clarifying offboarding, credential tracking, password rotation, and controls for credentials outside 1Password.

Obtained most application access listings and built a working inventory of 78 systems. PwC is classifying interactive and shared accounts and identifying where applicable credentials are not managed in 1Password.

Working in conjunction with system owners to help validate the accounts’ purpose and interactive capability across the 78 different systems.

Mapped identified credentials to 1Password vaults, members, and available password-change information. Root and recovery accounts appearing in vault membership have required additional work to determine who has access to the root accounts.

Performing the above uplift work has required multiple owner meetings and follow-ups as well as coordination across the entire PwC team, resulting in substantial hours being spent.

Metronome to Quipu migration: Credits Tracking/invoicing for overages ChatGPT / API (Nova implications)

We needed to reassess (Discovery) the controls previously in place for Metronome against the code and transaction flow now in Quipu, and we are seeing a significant number of changes impacting both the process and the controls.
We are trying to self-serve as much as possible, but we will need support from the control owners to obtain the test-of-one evidence.
As a result of this reassessment, we have developed a flowchart outlining the updated process and the preliminary control impact in NOVA. This week we are going to finalized the final controls to be tested this week with FRM, TPM and BP.

We’re seeing a significant number of changes impacting the controls to be tested across both the ChatGPT and API processes. We’re currently doing an uplift of the existing documentation based on the code we received, including rebuilding the process flows and flowcharts, validating our understanding with the BP team, and reassessing the controls and testing approach accordingly.
